Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: Three days after my open gallbladder surgery, I developed fever and chills with a headache. I also have right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath, along with a productive cough for the last 12 hours.
Can you tell me more about the cough? What color
Patient: My cough has been producing phlegm that’s yellowish to greenish, and it feels worse with coughing fits. I’ve also had chills and feel generally unwell since the fever started.
Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing
Patient: Yes, I do feel short of breath, especially when I’m moving around, but I don’t feel like I can’t breathe—I just notice it more than usual.
Have you noticed any swelling, redness, or

No, I haven’t noticed any swelling or redness in my leg or elsewhere, but I do feel more short of breath with movement. I also still have the right-sided chest pain that’s worse when I take a deep breath. I’m worried because I’ve been having fever and chills since the day after my surgery.
Have you had any nausea, vomiting, or

Patient: I haven’t had any nausea or vomiting, but I do feel very fatigued and unwell, and the fever and chills have persisted since the day after my surgery. I’m also still having the right-sided chest pain when I breathe in deeply.
Have you noticed any abdominal pain, especially around your

“Mostly it’s the fever, chills, cough with yellow-green phlegm, and the right-sided chest pain when I take a deep breath that’s bothering me most; my abdominal discomfort isn’t the main issue. I haven’t had significant nausea or vomiting, and the symptoms seem to have started right after the surgery and have continued.”

Patient: Yes, I’ve had some right-sided shoulder discomfort, but the main pain is the right chest pain that sharply gets worse with deep breaths. Patient: It’s about a 7 out of 10 when I breathe in deeply, and I haven’t fainted again, though I do feel weak and lightheaded at times.

Patient: The chest pain feels pretty constant but definitely gets worse with deeper breaths and coughing, and I also feel more short of breath when I try to walk or move. I haven’t noticed any redness or swelling in my leg, but my fever and chills have continued since after the surgery. I’m also feeling very weak and lightheaded at times.
